results.title: Decorator pattern — Wikipedia
results.snippet: In object-oriented programming, the decorator pattern is a design pattern that allows behavior to be added to an individual object, dynamically, without affecting the behavior of other objects from the same class. The decorator pattern is structural and is one of the 23 design patterns described by the Gang of Four (Gamma, Helm, Johnson, Vlissides). It is often used as an alternative to subclassing for extending functionality.
